about: EXT14 machine-readable status of every production step and switch. Validated by `npm run status:check` (tests/tools/status-validate.js). Local or staging results NEVER set a production field; only dated owner evidence from production does. Update this file whenever something is merged, installed, switched or verified.

scores.basis: unchanged: no production evidence has arrived

r15.note: believed not installed; Query C §6 confirms

report_totals.note: optional, not in the plan; EXT14 fixed missing-total handling

invoices.note: optional, not in the plan; storage and numbering for invoices (owner decisions of Nov 14). Adds row rules on its own two new tables: needs the owner's explicit approval like every draft

stock_count_adjustments.note: optional, not in the plan; owner-only approval of stock-count adjustments (owner decision of Nov 16). Adds row rules on its own two new tables and changes no stock figure: needs the owner's explicit approval like every draft

supplier_documents.note: optional, not in the plan; supplier document storage with owner-only review (owner decisions of Nov 16). Adds row rules on its own six new tables: needs the owner's explicit approval like every draft

supplier_document_files.note: optional, after drafts/36; private supplier document files, readable by the owner only (owner decision of Nov 21). Adds two rules on storage.objects for its own bucket: needs the owner's explicit approval like every draft

partial_receiving.note: optional, not in the plan; deliveries received line by line, returns to suppliers, customer-return inspection and linked corrections (owner rules of Nov 22, D-ops-5). Stock changes only on the owner's approval: needs the owner's explicit approval like every draft (review item 5)

shopify_payouts.note: optional, not in the plan; a read-only copy of Shopify Payments payouts and the list of money differences (owner request of Nov 22). Needs the owner's explicit approval and a read-only Shopify app the owner creates (review item 6)

staff_read_purchase_orders.note: optional, not in the plan; two read-only rules so all employees see purchase orders (owner decision of Nov 22). Needs the owner's explicit approval like every draft (review item 7)

tax_rates.note: optional, before the first real invoice; the owner's confirmed sales tax rates (start day, source, re-check after Jan 1 / Jul 1), owner-only writes (owner request of Nov 23). Needs the owner's explicit approval like every draft (review item 8)

shipments.note: optional, before the scan page marks parcels dropped off; parcels with their tracking numbers, one drop-off receipt marks every parcel on it (owner request of Nov 23). ADAPTED Nov 24 after the read-only shape check: it keeps its own tables (order_parcels, order_parcel_events) and only reads the Shipping/Tracking agent's shipments table, which it never changes. Needs the owner's explicit approval like every draft (review item 9)

shared_settings.note: optional; settings the owner types once, the same on every phone and computer (owner request of Nov 24); first use: the Real profit estimates. Owner-only writes. Needs the owner's explicit approval like every draft (review item 10)

order_costs.note: optional; the real fee and postage of each order, so Real profit uses exact figures where they are known (owner request of Nov 23). Owner and administrators only. Needs the owner's explicit approval like every draft (review item 11)

order_batches.note: optional; which batch went into which order, recorded by scanning the batch sticker when packing, so a batch problem gives one list of orders (owner decision of Nov 24). A wrong scan is voided, never deleted. Needs the owner's explicit approval like every draft (review item 12)

email_sending.note: optional; the records and rules for sending approved email campaigns: campaigns, an outbox, the do-not-email list, the slow start, the 90-day rest for stores, the automatic stop (owner decision of Nov 24). Nothing in it sends an email; the sending program is separate and needs the owner's own account with an email service. Needs the owner's explicit approval like every draft

my_settings.note: optional; the small choices that belong to one person (first use: what a person set aside until tomorrow on Home) follow that person to every device; each person reads and saves only their own (owner rule of Nov 24). Needs the owner's explicit approval like every draft

customer_reviews.note: optional; the reviews the owner pastes or types in on the Reviews page are kept in the database, so every device of the owner and the administrators shows the same reviews and the same answered marks (owner rule of Nov 24). Nothing in it posts or sends. Needs the owner's explicit approval like every draft

people_levels.note: optional; four levels of account (owner, administrator, manager, employee): each level sees and looks after the accounts below it, the database part of the New Employee page (owner's decision of Nov 24). Creates no sign-in; the page and the helper program that creates sign-ins come after. Before anyone is made a manager: a read-only look at how the existing rules treat an unknown level

agents.note: #4/#5/#6 on, #2/#3/#7/#8 off as reported by the owner; #1 UNVERIFIED
